\usepackage{fvextra}
\RecustomVerbatimEnvironment{Highlighting}{Verbatim}{
  commandchars=\\\{\},
  breaklines=true,
  breakanywhere=true,
  breaknonspaceingroup=true,
  breaksymbolleft={},
  breaksymbolright={},
  breakanywheresymbolpre={},
  breakanywheresymbolpost={}
}

\usepackage{mdframed}
\definecolor{NervixCodeBackground}{HTML}{F5F6FA}
\definecolor{NervixCodeBorder}{HTML}{D5D9E5}
\renewmdenv[
  backgroundcolor=NervixCodeBackground,
  linecolor=NervixCodeBorder,
  linewidth=0.6pt,
  leftmargin=0.5em,
  rightmargin=0.5em,
  innerleftmargin=0.8em,
  innerrightmargin=0.8em,
  innertopmargin=0.6em,
  innerbottommargin=0.6em,
  skipabove=0.7\baselineskip,
  skipbelow=0.7\baselineskip
]{Shaded}

\definecolor{NervixLink}{HTML}{212982}

\definecolor{NervixQuoteBackground}{HTML}{F3F4FA}
\definecolor{NervixQuoteRule}{HTML}{212982}
\renewmdenv[
  backgroundcolor=NervixQuoteBackground,
  linecolor=NervixQuoteRule,
  linewidth=2.5pt,
  leftline=true,
  rightline=false,
  topline=false,
  bottomline=false,
  leftmargin=1.5em,
  rightmargin=0.5em,
  innerleftmargin=1em,
  innerrightmargin=1em,
  innertopmargin=0.7em,
  innerbottommargin=0.7em,
  skipabove=0.8\baselineskip,
  skipbelow=0.8\baselineskip,
  font=\itshape
]{quote}
